CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

2. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.
   B. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.

3. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
